datasets.title: Flooding in the Philippines on October 29, 2024
datasets.description: This dataset shows the actual extent of flooding in the Philippines caused by typhoons or tropical cyclones as of October 29, 2024, as observed through available satellite imagery. The dataset can be used to track the progression of floods over time, identify areas at risk, and assess the impact of these natural disasters on infrastructure, agriculture, and local populations.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/philippines-flood-20241029]
datasets.details: This dataset has not been validated using ground-truth data.

lineage.description: Satellite imagery (optical and SAR) acquired on October 29, 2024 was processed by the Philippine Space Agency to delineate observed flood extent polygons caused by typhoon-induced precipitation and storm surge. The resulting vector and raster datasets represent post-event empirical observations of inundated areas used for damage assessment and disaster impact tracking.
